markdown: **Activate—Vile Stench** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645), [olfactory](/Traits.aspx?ID=664))   **Requirements** Your last action was a successful Strike with the _catoblepas maul_; **Effect** The target must succeed at a DC 30 Fortitude save or become [sickened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=91) 1 (plus [slowed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=92) 1 for as long as it’s sickened on a critical failure). A creature that succeeds at its save becomes temporarily immune to Vile Stench for 1 minute.
